children: shares rose more than 3% in premarket trading on Friday after investment firm CFRA upgraded the storage company to Buy from Sell.

Everpure's recent guidance boost “brings validation to its thesis that its all-flash deployments are becoming the platform of choice in AI data centers and in fact benefit from high NAND prices given superior efficiency,” CFRA analysts wrote in a note to clients.

In addition, CFRA said it sees the potential for “further upside as AI demand keeps rising, with the potential for additional hyperscaler partnerships going forward.” The investment firm has a $149 price target on Everpure shares.

Earlier this week, Everpure said it expects fiscal 2028 revenue of $7B to $7.3B, up 39% to 45% from the prior year. The outlook compares with analyst consensus of $6.37B. The company expects non-GAAP operating income of $1.7B to $1.9B, up 80% to 100%.

For fiscal 2027, Everpure reaffirmed revenue guidance of $5.03B to $5.07B, compared with analyst estimates of $5.05B. The company said three newer businesses — Modern Data Software, Scale AI, and Hyperscale Solutions — are expected to account for about 20% of revenue by fiscal 2030. Its other growth areas include Core and Core AI, which cover its storage products and subscription services.

title: Everpure rises on back of CFRA upgrade
